original_test_intent: Downgrade the exact BMC firmware through BMC WebUI with Preserve all Configuration selected and verify version, configuration and management recovery.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Use WebUI to upload/confirm the approved older image and validate post-activation state.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Target version is active, preserved configuration is correct, and BMC/host management remains healthy.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED to REQUIRES; preserved WebUI and rejected assumed Redfish replacement.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer selects image/path and gives run-level approval; WebUI operation remains engineer-controlled unless an approved browser path exists.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: WebUI downgrade with preserve-all intent is retained.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Exact source/target versions, image/signature, support matrix, outage and recovery plan.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: A Redfish inventory query or different update channel cannot claim WebUI downgrade completion.

original_method: Retain BMC WebUI downgrade and preserve-setting selection.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a vendor-advertised update mechanism only if the project explicitly changes the execution method while preserving downgrade/configuration coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: API update does not validate the WebUI path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Anti-rollback, incompatible configuration and flash/power failure can brick management.

missing_inputs: Signed image and supported downgrade path
safety_boundaries: No upload until target/image/version are verified
No invented action URI or automatic retry
expected_evidence: Image provenance and complete WebUI record
Task/activation logs and restored management/host health
no_automatic_retry: Any uncertain flash state blocks retry and requires vendor/engineer disposition.
engineer_owned_verdict: Engineer owns acceptance and any recovery decision.
review_improvement: V3 already correctly separated interface coverage and readiness; V3.1 adds explicit run-level approval and no-retry treatment.
